SELECT v.id, v.legal_name, v.criticality, v.current_risk,
       v.primary_contact->>'email' AS email,
       CASE WHEN v.criticality >= 4 THEN 90 WHEN v.criticality = 3 THEN 180 ELSE 365 END AS interval_days
FROM vendors v
WHERE (
    (v.status IN ('approved','conditional','monitoring') AND (v.next_evaluation IS NULL OR v.next_evaluation <= now()))
    OR (v.status = 'reevaluation' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM assessments expired
      WHERE expired.vendor_id = v.id AND expired.status = 'expired'
    ))
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assessments a
                  WHERE a.vendor_id = v.id AND a.status IN ('pending','in_progress'))
ORDER BY v.criticality DESC, v.next_evaluation NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 50;

WITH a AS (
  INSERT INTO assessments (vendor_id, questionnaire_id, status, started_at)
  SELECT $1::uuid, q.id, 'pending', now()
  FROM questionnaires q WHERE q.is_active = true
  ORDER BY q.version DESC LIMIT 1
  RETURNING id, vendor_id
), v AS (
  UPDATE vendors
     SET status = 'reevaluation'::vendor_status,
         next_evaluation = now() + make_interval(days => $2::int),
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT a.id AS assessment_id, a.vendor_id FROM a JOIN v ON v.id = a.vendor_id;

WITH expired AS (
  UPDATE assessments
     SET status = 'expired', portal_token_hash = NULL, token_expires_at = NULL
   WHERE status IN ('pending','in_progress')
     AND token_expires_at IS NOT NULL
     AND token_expires_at <= now()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS expired_assessments FROM expired;
